summary: Leg day. Today's cafeteria skipped the usual Mary's chicken rotation, so lunch leans on the smokehouse Smoked Chicken plus extra chicken breast, rice and black beans; dinner is a big chicken-and-whole-grain-pasta bowl with roasted broccoli to load carbs for leg-day recovery. Pre-workout keeps the protein-powder Strawberry Mango Tajin Smoothie since no cottage cheese smoothie is on today's menu.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Eggs and turkey for protein, oats, rye toast and fruit for steady carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Smoked Chicken as the main (new today, no Mary's dishes on the menu), extra chicken breast, wild rice and black beans for carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat protein smoothie plus half a bagel, turkey and raspberries for easy carbs and protein before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Big chicken and whole grain pasta bowl with roasted broccoli and parmesan to load carbs after the leg session.
